view.heroKicker: Established experience · Engineering capability · Responsive service
view.companySummaryHeading: Building lasting trust through verifiable experience
view.companySummaryBody:
Since its founding in Taiwan in 1998, JIEPING CO., LTD (JP PUMP) has focused on its customers’ long-term needs. Beyond installing and repairing pumps, we help plan complete pumping systems suited to the operating conditions of each site.
We aim to be a trusted partner at every stage of a project, with experience extending to Japan, Vietnam, and Palau.

parts.text: residential, industrial, and commercial sites as well as major landmarks
, each with distinct needs and project scales.
Taipei Dome, Taipei 101, Taichung MRT G03, and the FISU Games Village
; at some sites, we continue to support
after installation to meet ongoing operational needs.

partnerParagraphs: Grundfos established a pump production factory in Taiwan in 1989 and a Taiwan sales company in 1991. It was the first foreign company to establish pump manufacturing in Taiwan. It currently has approximately 277 employees and produced more than 180,000 pumps in Taiwan in 2024.
Grundfos provides solutions for building water supply, industrial processes, semiconductor ultrapure water, HVAC pumps and intelligent water treatment.

seriesDescriptions.jp-pump-hs: HS submersible well pump series. Its vertical design saves space and is suitable for basement water storage tanks in buildings.
seriesDescriptions.jp-pump-vbsg: VFJH variable frequency constant pressure pump with stable water pressure, quiet operation, and motor overload and dry-running protection.
seriesDescriptions.jp-pump-kh-vbsg: VFJQ variable frequency constant pressure pump with stable flow, quiet operation, and motor overload and dry-running protection.
seriesDescriptions.jp-pump-gp: GP close-coupled volute pump series with a mechanical shaft seal designed to prevent leakage and shaft wear.
seriesDescriptions.jp-pump-cv: CV submersible sewage pump series for liquid temperatures of 0–40°C, with 35–50 mm solids passage and standard motor overheating protection.
seriesDescriptions.jp-pump-sn: SN submersible sewage pump series for liquid temperatures of 0–40°C, with 6 mm solids passage and standard motor overheating protection.
seriesDescriptions.jp-pump-tp: TP submersible sewage pump series with standard motor overheating protection, automatic reset, and a wear-resistant resin impeller.
seriesDescriptions.jp-pump-jq: JQ electronic pressure boosting pump integrates a motor, pump, pressure tank, and controller for household water pressure boosting and rooftop tank supply.
seriesDescriptions.jp-pump-sb-sbi-sbn: JS/JSI/JSN vertical multistage centrifugal pump series with stainless steel impellers, outer casing, and pressure chamber.
seriesDescriptions.grundfos-2cm: 2CM Booster twin-pump variable frequency constant pressure system adjusts pump operation to water demand.
seriesDescriptions.grundfos-2cr-i-n-booster: 2CR(I,N) Booster twin-pump variable frequency constant pressure system adjusts pump operation to water demand.
seriesDescriptions.grundfos-cm-cme: CM/CME horizontal multistage end-suction centrifugal pump series for industrial pressure boosting, water supply, and HVAC circulation.
seriesDescriptions.grundfos-cr-cri-crn: CR/CRI/CRN vertical multistage centrifugal pump series.
seriesDescriptions.grundfos-dwk-dpk: DWK/DPK submersible drainage pump series for construction sites, mines, and temporary drainage.
seriesDescriptions.grundfos-sp-a-sp: SP A/SP submersible pumps, motors, and accessories, with a published flow range of 1 to 330 m³/h.
seriesDescriptions.grundfos-sc-hc: SC/HC sewage and wastewater pump series for sewage, waste, and wastewater discharge.
seriesDescriptions.grundfos-magna3: MAGNA3 circulator series includes cast iron or stainless steel single-head and twin-head pumps across a broad performance range.
seriesDescriptions.grundfos-hydro-mpc: Hydro MPC pressure boosting system built around Grundfos CR multistage centrifugal pumps.
seriesDescriptions.jp-pump-vf: VF variable frequency constant pressure system integrates a pump, inverter control panel, pressure transmitter, and pressure tank to maintain stable supply pressure.
seriesDescriptions.grundfos-upa: Grundfos automatic domestic pressure booster pump.
seriesDescriptions.grundfos-nb-nbg-nk-nkg-nbe-nbge-nke-nkge: NB/NBG/NK/NKG/NBE/NBGE/NKE/NKGE single-stage end-suction centrifugal pump series, with standard and variable frequency versions for industrial water supply and HVAC circulation.
